name: Cuantización de Fase Local
description: Analiza local phase information in the dominio de frecuencia para detectar limited phase diversity in generado por IA textures.
algorithm: LPQ Descriptor with Short-Term Fourier Transform
mechanism: Computes STFT at each pixel neighborhood and quantizes the phase of frequency components. AI images typically exhibit concentrated LPQ distribucións with limited phase diversity.
parameters: Window: 5×5, Frequencies: 4 basis, Quantization: 8-bit binary code, Histogram: 256 bins
source: Ojansivu & Heikkilä (2008) — Blur Insensitive Texture Classification, ICISP
useCase: Detecting reduced phase diversity in generado por IA local textures

references.title: Ojansivu, V. & Heikkilä, J. (2008). Blur Insensitive Texture Classification Using LPQ. ICISP.

strengths:
• Blur-insensitive texture descriptor
• Captures phase information lost in magnitude-only methods
• Robust to moderate image degradation
• Complementary to LBP análisis
limitations:
• Computacionalmente costoso
• Limited spatial resolución
• May not capture large-scale patrones
• Best used in combination with other methods
